result.title: Robust Explanatory Analysis for Structured Optimization Networks (REASON) in Learning
result.summary: We seek a hierarchical resolution of residual error under a composite learning objective as a principled mechanism for identifying and exploiting additional information, particularly under distribution shift and perturbation. Inspired by the System 1/System 2 paradigm, we formulate this principle as a two-loop mechanism serving a common inference goal. A fast, System 1-like loop resolves the residual addressable by the available evidence; the remaining epistemic residual triggers a medium speed, System 2-like loop that actively acquires additional evidence and measures its informational value through residual reduction. Over nested solution spaces, the medium-loop optimum is provably no worse than the fast-loop optimum. Experiments show that the resulting two-loop model consistently improves upon the fast loop at approximately half the computation of the medium loop, including under unseen corruptions, and, when provided a cleaner observation, outperforms staged classifiers and learning-to-defer methods at equal computational cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 REASON 两环路机制：快速环先用现有证据消解可解残差，残余的认知残差再触发中速环主动获取额外证据，并以残差下降衡量其信息价值。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「残差触发追加计算、按信息价值决定是否继续取证」的元推理框架，可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的动态计算分配与停止决策形成概念类比，可供核查；但论文未涉及视觉语言模型或 latent 状态，属远域启发。
